name: How long does it take to hang new drywall in a typical room?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to hang new drywall in a typical room?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for hanging new drywall in a typical room (e.g., 12x12 feet) can vary depending on factors like ceiling height, wall complexity, and the number of openings. Generally, installation, taping, and the multiple drying/sanding cycles for joint compound can take anywhere from 3 to 7 days. This estimate does not include demolition or final painting, focusing solely on the drywall process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hanging new drywall in a typical room can take 3 to 7 days, including installation, taping, and compound drying/sanding.
